nodes.label: package exports
nodes.desc: Re-exports serve, client, and the legacy MIIServer/MIIClient classes.

nodes.label: mii.serve()
nodes.desc: Creates a persistent deployment: parses kwargs, writes the score file, boots the server, returns a client.

nodes.label: mii.client()
nodes.desc: Reconnects to an existing deployment by loading its saved config.

nodes.label: non-persistent loader
nodes.desc: In-process path that builds an engine and tokenizer without standing up a server.

nodes.label: ModelConfig
nodes.desc: Per-model settings: tensor_parallel, quantization_mode (wf6af16 FP6 weights), replica_num, device_map, max_length.

nodes.label: MIIConfig
nodes.desc: Deployment settings: port_number, enable_restful_api, restful ports, hostfile.

nodes.label: generate_replica_configs
nodes.desc: Allocates GPUs and ports per replica from the hostfile via _allocate_devices.

nodes.label: DeploymentType
nodes.desc: LOCAL vs AML deployment enums, GRPC_MAX_MSG_SIZE, LB_MAX_WORKER_THREADS.

nodes.label: MIIServer
nodes.desc: Generates replica configs then spawns every process and waits for sockets to open.

nodes.label: _launch_server_process
nodes.desc: Builds the deepspeed launch command with a base64-encoded ModelConfig.

nodes.label: multi_gpu_server.main()
nodes.desc: Module entry for every spawned process; routes to inference, load balancer, or gateway role.

nodes.label: create_score_file
nodes.desc: Writes score.py under the MII cache so deployments can be reloaded by name.

nodes.label: import_score_file / init_distributed
nodes.desc: Loads generated score modules and initializes NCCL process groups.

nodes.label: load_model
nodes.desc: Calls DeepSpeed build_hf_engine to produce an optimized InferenceEngineV2.

nodes.label: load_tokenizer
nodes.desc: Wraps the HuggingFace tokenizer as an MIITokenizerWrapper.

nodes.label: RaggedBatchBase
nodes.desc: Request queues, ZMQ PUB/SUB sockets for TP ranks, and the generate() main loop.

nodes.label: MIIAsyncPipeline
nodes.desc: Server-facing engine: put_request, get_response, flush_uid drive continuous batching.

nodes.label: Request / Response
nodes.desc: Dataclasses carrying prompts, token blocks, and generation results.

nodes.label: run_batch_* helpers
nodes.desc: Applies logit processing, sampling, and stop criteria across the ragged batch.

nodes.label: LogitsSampler / GreedySampler
nodes.desc: Top-k / top-p / temperature sampling over next-token logits.

nodes.label: TopP / TopK / Temperature processors
nodes.desc: Per-request logit transforms before sampling.

nodes.label: Eos / Token stop criteria
nodes.desc: Decides when a sequence finishes: EOS token or stop strings.

nodes.label: MIIClient
nodes.desc: Async gRPC client; generate() packs prompts and unpacks Response objects.

nodes.label: ModelResponse servicer
nodes.desc: GeneratorReply / GeneratorReplyStream handlers feeding the batching engine.

nodes.label: LoadBalancingInterceptor
nodes.desc: Round-robins incoming RPCs across replica stubs via AtomicCounter.

nodes.label: TASK_METHODS_DICT
nodes.desc: Per-task proto packing/unpacking for text generation requests.

nodes.label: RestfulGatewayThread
nodes.desc: Flask app exposing POST /mii/{deployment_name} backed by mii.client.

nodes.label: ModelResponseStub
nodes.desc: Generated gRPC stub shared by clients, load balancer, and REST frontends.

nodes.label: /generate FastAPI server
nodes.desc: Simple REST surface with streaming support over the load balancer.

nodes.label: OpenAI-compatible server
nodes.desc: Serves /v1/chat/completions and /v1/completions with optional API keys.

nodes.label: pydantic request models
nodes.desc: ChatCompletionRequest / CompletionRequest payloads and responses.

nodes.label: legacy load_models
nodes.desc: Pre-FastGen path that injects DeepSpeed inference kernels into HF models.

nodes.label: replace_with_kernel_inject
nodes.desc: Legacy switch for kernel injection and CUDA graph capture at load time.
